---
title: "🛏️ Transport Checklist"
subtitle: "Pre-transport EVD safety review"
---

Complete this checklist prior to intra-hospital transport or procedures.

```{ojs}
checklistItems = {
  const { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, collection, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(collection(db, "TransportChecklistItems"), snapshot => {
      notify(snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data()).sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0)));
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
pre_items = checklistItems.filter(i => i.section === "pre").map(i => i.text)
```

```{ojs}
during_items = checklistItems.filter(i => i.section === "during").map(i => i.text)
```

## Pre-Transport

```{ojs}
viewof pre_checked = Inputs.checkbox(pre_items, {label: ""})
```

## During Transport

```{ojs}
viewof during_checked = Inputs.checkbox(during_items, {label: ""})
```

## Readiness Status

```{ojs}
total = pre_items.length + during_items.length
completed = pre_checked.length + during_checked.length

total === 0
  ? html`<div class="fs-empty">Loading…</div>`
  : html`<div style="padding:15px;border-radius:10px;
      background:${completed === total ? '#e8f5e9' : '#fdecea'};
      border-left:6px solid ${completed === total ? '#27ae60' : '#e74c3c'};">
      ${completed === total
        ? "✅ Ready for Transport"
        : `⚠️ ${total - completed} item(s) remaining`}
    </div>`
```

## Key Reference

**Enhancing Safety in Intrahospital Transport of Patients With External Ventricular Drains Through Simulation-Based Training.**
Bharadwaj MS, Abu-Alya A, Fochs A, Liau C, McGlennen KM, Ishimoto L, Bjurstrom M, Guo S, Khadka S, Teske T, Vu TT, Lele AV.
